title: The write step keeps one space before an emphasis line break, and the host page measure steps over a hidden break, so a heading never reads as two glued words
steps: S1: From the checkout run: node --test --test-concurrency=1 apps/tracy-web/test/site-copy-check-emphasis.test.mjs
S3: Read the exit codes and the fail/skipped counts.
expect: S1 exits 0 with 0 failures: 'A lesson in the pool' with the emphasis 'pool' exports as 'A lesson in the ((br/))((span))pool((/span))', and extra spaces before the break are never doubled.
S2 exits 0 with 0 failures and 0 skipped: a break the page hides does not stand between the words, and a space beside a hidden break or a visible break does.
fence: The exported text of a slot and the words the host measure reads from a page. Not exercised: a live customer build.
